strengths: Comprehensive B-cell marker support (MS4A1, CD79A, CD79B, BANK1, BLK, CD37)
Correctly identifies FCER2 and TCL1A as naive B-cell state markers
Distinguishes B-cell MHC class II expression from dendritic-cell identity
weaknesses: Structured top1 remains parent-level B cell (CL:0000236); naive state appears only in topk/reasoning
CD27 negativity inferred from absence among top markers rather than direct measurement

strengths: Top2 naive B cell (CL:0000788) provides exact supported descendant
weaknesses: Naive B-cell hypothesis is down-weighted as rank2, not the final top1

strengths: Top label captures mature naive B-cell state
Highlights canonical mature B-cell markers and absence of T/NK/plasma markers
weaknesses: Mapped to parent CL:0000785 instead of exact naive B cell CL:0000788
Lower-ranked NK/T candidates (CL:0000824, CL:0002419) are unsupported by DEGs

supporting: Top DEGs MS4A1, CD79A, CD79B, BANK1, BLK, CD37, VPREB3 and IGLL5 support B-cell lineage.
FCER2 and TCL1A are top positive DEGs supporting the added naive component (CD23+/TCL1A+ naive mature B-cell phenotype).
Absence of CD27, MZB1, XBP1, SDC1 and JCHAIN among top DEGs supports non-memory/non-plasma mature B-cell identity.
MHC class II antigen presentation enrichment (HLA-DRA, HLA-DQA1, HLA-DRB1, CD74) is consistent with B-cell antigen-presenting function
conflicting: T-cell (CD3D/CD3E), NK-cell (FCGR3A/FGFBP2) and plasma-cell (MZB1/XBP1/SDC1/JCHAIN) markers are absent.
TCR/ZAP-70 and CD3-related enrichment terms are generic immune pathway overlaps and are not supported by positive T-cell lineage markers.
enrichment_or_literature: MHC class II antigen processing/presentation and adaptive immune system enrichment are consistent with B-cell identity.
PMID 34680286 is cited for B-cell marker interpretation.

provenance.note: Publication-facing final decision, evidence, QC disposition and evaluation fields are synchronized to the submitted Supplementary Data.
